SELECT SEQ_QUERY_EXECUTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QUERY_EXECUTION ( EXECUTION_ID, BATCH_ID, QUERY_ID, EXECUTED_BY, RETRY_OF_EXECUTION_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{executionId}, #{batchId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{queryId}, #{executedBy}, #{retryOfExecutionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{attemptNo}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE QUERY_EXECUTION SET STATUS = 'RUNNING', STARTED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE QUERY_EXECUTION SET STATUS='PENDING', STARTED_AT=NULL, FINISHED_AT=NULL, DURATION_MS=NULL, ERROR_CODE=NULL, ERROR_MESSAGE=NULL WHERE EXECUTION_ID=#{executionId} AND STATUS='RUNNING'

UPDATE QUERY_EXECUTION SET STATUS = #{status}, FINISHED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, DURATION_MS = #{durationMs, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ERROR_CODE = #{errorCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND #{status} IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.BATCH_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.DRAFTER_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.STATUS AS EXECUTION_STATUS, B.BATCH_STATUS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, I.SQL_TEXT FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID AND B.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND ( E.BATCH_ID IS NULL OR B.BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND E.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND E.QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND E.BATCH_ID IS NULL AND E.STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID AND I.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_RESULT F WHERE F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_EXECUTION RETRY WHERE RETRY.RETRY_OF_EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID )
mapper.select: SELECT I.QUERY_ID, E.EXECUTION_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.STATUS FROM QUERY_ITEM I LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EXECUTION_ID, QUERY_ID, BATCH_ID, STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY QUERY_ID ORDER BY EXECUTION_ID DESC ) AS LATEST_RANK FROM QUERY_EXECUTION ) E ON E.QUERY_ID = I.QUERY_ID AND E.LATEST_RANK = 1 WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_ID
